by: visual chat (游戏视觉), exit-sign-chevrons build (C23 step 2, 2026-10-22), for 平面视觉's K-sheets and its chevron sign-off (shape, weight, stubs)

figma.placed: not yet: 平面视觉 places the 2 sheets after K82/K83 (the closed hanging and flush sheets)

source.models: the 4 punched-chevron kits built in W/proj_chev from the clone's exit_sign_geom.py / exit_sign_common.py / exit_sign_hanging.py and the 4 new modules (chevrons/20_build.md §2); not in main yet
source.renderClone: W/proj_chev (mkclone.sh proj_chev --feature exit_sign from main 0ea38bb7 + working tree, 2026-10-22 07:49; compiled OSXUniversal, 0 errors)
source.command: Unity -batchmode -buildTarget OSXUniversal -projectPath W/proj_chev -executeMethod FrontRoomsThreeView.RunBatch -quit -threeViewOut W/chev_work/threeview/raw -threeViewOnly Kit_ExitSign_Hanging_ChevL,Kit_ExitSign_Hanging_ChevR,Kit_ExitSign_HangingFlush_ChevL,Kit_ExitSign_HangingFlush_ChevR -frGlassRT off

conventions.pngPerSheetPx: PNG px = 2 x sheet px; place each PNG at 50 % so the sheet reads at sheetPpm
conventions.sheetPpmNote: The tool's ladder, as for the closed kits: the hanging pair reads at 500 (0.612 m with its stems), the flush pair at 2000
conventions.groundLine: Part-frame kits: drawn about their origin, not on a floor. The PNG top (less padding) is the ceiling plane, the sign hangs below it
conventions.views: third-angle: front = camera on +Z (the front face: _ChevL reads <EXIT, _ChevR EXIT>), side = the kit's right (camera on -X), top = from above with the front toward the image bottom, persp = 3/4 hero from the front-left, 22 deg up, 1152 x 864
conventions.litFace: The diffuser renders at the material default _LampField (1, 1, 0, 0) = LIT (no driver in the studio). The studio camera has no HDR and no post: the letters clip to a full red; the chevron, lit only by the cavity fill, renders darker (see renderedHex)
conventions.swatchRule: hex = sRGB of ( linear(mean of the _BaseMap's sRGB pixels) x linear(_BaseColor) ), read from Resources/Surfaces/<slot>.mat in the render clone (interactables/threeview/tools/swatch.py); Prop_Chrome reuses the existing K-sheet hex (equal under the rule). The glow swatch is the emission colour at its peak

verification.checks: 16 / 16 PNGs: exactly 16 px clear margin on every orthographic view; 0 magenta; 0 opaque black px except 167 on each flush front, the same pixels as the closed Kit_ExitSign_HangingFlush front (the dark gap under its canopy); 4 / 4 kits ok, none failed
verification.topViewNote: The ceiling kits' top views look into the canopy pan, which is open on its ceiling side (exit_sign_common.build_canopy)

sheets.title: Exit sign · hanging · chevron
sheets.lede: The hanging sign with one chevron punched through on both faces: front <EXIT, back EXIT>, both pointing the same way.

era.label: Period
era.note: The same 1977–93 incandescent stencil-face sign as the closed kits, with ONE chevron knockout punched out by the installer: a 1990 universal sign is stamped with both 2.25 in chevrons as scored knockouts (UL 924-1989: outside the legend, >= 3/8 in from any letter, not easy to reverse, unused openings covered; NFPA 101-1988 asks for 'a directional indicator'; the 2.25 in size is the March 1991 NIST proposal). Three broken hold-tab stubs stay on the cut. Red letters; no LED, no running man, no brand, no date.

materials.name: ExitSign_Housing
materials.label: White enamel (pan, canopy)
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/ExitSign_Housing.mat: mean of ExitSign_Enamel_A.png x _BaseColor [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] (tint sRGB->linear, product -> sRGB); metallic 0, smoothness = the _S mask's R (capped at 0.60) x _Smoothness 1

materials.name: ExitSign_Face
materials.label: Stencil plate, white enamel (the unused knockout stays scored)
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/ExitSign_Face.mat: mean of ExitSign_Face_A.png x _BaseColor [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] (tint sRGB->linear, product -> sRGB); metallic 0, smoothness = the _S mask's R (capped at 0.60) x _Smoothness 1

materials.name: ExitSign_Diffuser
materials.label: Red acrylic diffuser (seen through the letters and the punched chevron)
materials.source: Resources/Surfaces/ExitSign_Diffuser.mat: mean of ExitSign_Diffuser_A.png x _BaseColor [1.0, 0.248, 0.248] (tint sRGB->linear, product -> sRGB); metallic 1, smoothness = the _S mask's R (capped at 0.60) x _Smoothness 0.3

materials.name: ExitSign_Diffuser (glow)
materials.label: Lit letters and chevron (lamp glow)
materials.source: ExitSign_Diffuser.mat _EmissionColor (3.2, 0.013, 0.006) linear, shown at its peak (R = 1); the shader multiplies it by the lamp field (ExitSign_Diffuser_F). The open chevron sits in the cavity fill, far from both lamps: LIT field 0.126 against the I's 0.579 (research/exit_sign/chevrons/tools/field_means.json). renderedHex = mean of the open chevron in the _ChevL front three-view (studio, no HDR, no post). In game: see colour

materials.name: Prop_Chrome
materials.label: Chrome (stems, collars, nuts, screws)
materials.source: existing K-sheet swatch (PROP KIT 2324:852), same rule

members: Exit zone only (C23 step 2): over each opening one step closer to the exit, where the ceiling is >= 2.65 m; placed by the level-design chat (C-3 ceiling placement, route distance, chevron side)
FrontRoomsExitSign deals it LIT 70 % · HALF 15 % · LOOSE 15 %, static per seed; no sign light
The map's pick: s = Dot(signWorldRotation * Vector3.right, d) >= 0.707 -> _ChevL, <= -0.707 -> _ChevR (chevrons/10_spec §3.2)
sheets.variantNote: The mirror: front EXIT>, back <EXIT, both pointing to local -X (_ChevL turned 180 deg about Y).

tris.note: LOD1 from 5 m and never culled (lodDistances 0 = no further step); no LOD2, like the whole sign family (a 300-triangle LOD2 cannot hold the stencil holes; chevrons/10_spec §4.1). LOD0 = the closed parent + 284 (the punched chevron, both faces); the plate is kept whole in LOD1, so the chevron survives the switch

colour.note: In game (HDR capture path of 60_fix1.md, lens distortion 0): the open chevron's graded body reads sRGB (134.5, 35.0, 21.8), hue 7.0 deg, saturation 0.84 in a dark room at 1.5 m (predicted (140, 36, 23), 6.8 deg) and hue 7.0-7.4 deg, saturation 0.83-0.84 in lit rooms at 0.3-12 m (narrow-FOV measure frames): inside 平面视觉's 0-8 deg / >= 0.80 targets. Raw: 0.22 x the I and 0.43-0.50 x the E when LIT (field 0.22 / 0.42), 0.48-0.52 x LIT in either HALF, 1.70-1.77 x the E on BATTERY (the brightest hole). Luminance contrast to the plate swings with the light on the face: 0.79 with a lit face, 0.30 between troffer rows (the lit E: 0.54 / 0.35); the dark-room luminance direction bar of CH-10 fails (raw Y open/closed 1.03-1.33 at the game's FOV) because the white plate sits at raw Y 0.037 under the game's ambient; the fallback F1, emulated, does not pass it either (1.23-1.63). Open for Red / 平面视觉 (20_build.md §4.3)

colour.note: In game (HDR capture path of 60_fix1.md, lens distortion 0): the open chevron's graded body reads sRGB (134.5, 35.0, 21.8), hue 7.0 deg, saturation 0.84 in a dark room at 1.5 m (predicted (140, 36, 23), 6.8 deg) and hue 7.0-7.4 deg, saturation 0.83-0.84 in lit rooms at 0.3-12 m (narrow-FOV measure frames): inside 平面视觉's 0-8 deg / >= 0.80 targets. Raw: 0.22 x the I and 0.43-0.50 x the E when LIT (field 0.22 / 0.42), 0.48-0.52 x LIT in either HALF, 1.70-1.77 x the E on BATTERY (the brightest hole). Luminance contrast to the plate swings with the light on the face: 0.79 with a lit face, 0.30 between troffer rows (the lit E: 0.54 / 0.35); the dark-room luminance direction bar of CH-10 fails (raw Y open/closed 1.03-1.33 at the game's FOV) because the white plate sits at raw Y 0.037 under the game's ambient; the fallback F1, emulated, does not pass it either (1.23-1.63).
